cues.title: Paladin sword swing
cues.brief: Air displacement and a thin steel edge, distinct from impact.

cues.title: Paladin sword contact
cues.brief: Steel-on-armor contact with crisp inharmonic ring and brief body.

cues.title: Ranger bow release
cues.brief: Plucked bowstring and a separate arrow departure.

cues.title: Ranger arrow impact
cues.brief: Contact, short crack and shaft vibration; no release repeated.

cues.title: Mage arcane release
cues.brief: Ascending, modulated arcane energy with controlled noise.

cues.title: Mage arcane impact
cues.brief: Crystalline contact distinct from the rising release.

cues.title: Rogue staff bell: basic
cues.brief: One spherical loose-shell jingle, two short impacts; no handbell sustain.

cues.title: Rogue staff bell: performance
cues.brief: The same small loose-shell bell, three short rhythmic jingle clusters.

cues.title: Creature claw contact
cues.brief: Short organic tear, scratch and physical body instead of pitched chime.

cues.title: Danger warning study
cues.brief: Two short distinct pulses; experimental only, not a replacement for the live warning.
